new.brief: Creates a new `GtkColumnViewColumn` that uses the given `factory` for mapping items to widgets.
new.md:
Creates a new `GtkColumnViewColumn` that uses the given `factory` for
mapping items to widgets.

You most likely want to call [`ColumnView.append_column()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ColumnView#method:append_column) next.

The function takes ownership of the argument, so you can write code like:

```c
column = gtk_column_view_column_new (_("Name"),
  gtk_builder_list_item_factory_new_from_resource ("/name.ui"));
```

doc.md:
Represents the columns in a `GtkColumnView`.

The main ingredient for a `GtkColumnViewColumn` is the `GtkListItemFactory`
that tells the columnview how to create cells for this column from items in
the model.

Columns have a title, and can optionally have a header menu set
with [`ColumnViewColumn.set_header_menu()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ColumnViewColumn#method:set_header_menu).

A sorter can be associated with a column using
[`ColumnViewColumn.set_sorter()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ColumnViewColumn#method:set_sorter), to let users influence sorting
by clicking on the column header.

get_column_view.brief: Gets the column view that's currently displaying this column.
get_column_view.md:
Gets the column view that's currently displaying this column.

If `self` has not been added to a column view yet, `NULL` is returned.

get_expand.brief: Returns whether this column should expand.
get_expand.md: Returns whether this column should expand.

get_factory.brief: Gets the factory that's currently used to populate list items for this column.
get_factory.md:
Gets the factory that's currently used to populate list items
for this column.

get_fixed_width.brief: Gets the fixed width of the column.
get_fixed_width.md: Gets the fixed width of the column.

get_header_menu.brief: Gets the menu model that is used to create the context menu for the column header.
get_header_menu.md:
Gets the menu model that is used to create the context menu
for the column header.

get_resizable.brief: Returns whether this column is resizable.
get_resizable.md: Returns whether this column is resizable.

get_sorter.brief: Returns the sorter that is associated with the column.
get_sorter.md: Returns the sorter that is associated with the column.

get_visible.brief: Returns whether this column is visible.
get_visible.md: Returns whether this column is visible.

set_expand.brief: Sets the column to take available extra space.
set_expand.md:
Sets the column to take available extra space.

The extra space is shared equally amongst all columns that
have are set to expand.

set_factory.brief: Sets the `GtkListItemFactory` to use for populating list items for this column.
set_factory.md:
Sets the `GtkListItemFactory` to use for populating list items
for this column.

set_fixed_width.brief: Sets the fixed width of the column.
set_fixed_width.md:
Sets the fixed width of the column.

If `fixed_width` is -1, the fixed width of the column is unset.

Setting a fixed width overrides the automatically calculated
width. Interactive resizing also sets the “fixed-width” property.

set_header_menu.brief: Sets the menu model that is used to create the context menu for the column header.
set_header_menu.md:
Sets the menu model that is used to create the context menu
for the column header.

set_id.brief: Sets the id of this column.
set_id.md:
Sets the id of this column.

GTK makes no use of this, but applications can use it when
storing column view configuration.

It is up to callers to ensure uniqueness of IDs.

set_resizable.brief: Sets whether this column should be resizable by dragging.
set_resizable.md: Sets whether this column should be resizable by dragging.

set_sorter.brief: Associates a sorter with the column.
set_sorter.md:
Associates a sorter with the column.

If `sorter` is unset, the column will not let users change
the sorting by clicking on its header.

This sorter can be made active by clicking on the column
header, or by calling [`ColumnView.sort_by_column()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ColumnView#method:sort_by_column).

See [`ColumnView.get_sorter()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ColumnView#method:get_sorter) for the necessary steps
for setting up customizable sorting for [`ColumnView`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ColumnView).

set_title.brief: Sets the title of this column.
set_title.md:
Sets the title of this column.

The title is displayed in the header of a `GtkColumnView`
for this column and is therefore user-facing text that should
be translated.

set_visible.brief: Sets whether this column should be visible in views.
set_visible.md: Sets whether this column should be visible in views.

column-view.brief: The `GtkColumnView` this column is a part of.
column-view.md: The `GtkColumnView` this column is a part of.

expand.brief: Column gets share of extra width allocated to the view.
expand.md: Column gets share of extra width allocated to the view.

factory.md:
Factory for populating list items.

The factory must be for configuring [`ColumnViewCell`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ColumnViewCell) objects.

fixed-width.brief: If not -1, this is the width that the column is allocated, regardless of the size of its content.
fixed-width.md:
If not -1, this is the width that the column is allocated,
regardless of the size of its content.

header-menu.brief: Menu model used to create the context menu for the column header.
header-menu.md: Menu model used to create the context menu for the column header.

id.md:
An ID for the column.

GTK is not currently using the ID for anything, but
it can be used by applications when saving column view
configurations.

It is up to applications to ensure uniqueness of IDs.

sorter.brief: Sorter for sorting items according to this column.
sorter.md: Sorter for sorting items according to this column.
